subject.title: [Bug]: Windows gateway listens but local health/status time out after Telegram polling stall (v2026.5.20)

question: Should unrecovered Telegram/channel stalls that leave Gateway alive but unresponsive escalate to supervised Gateway process recovery, or should recovery stay channel/session-scoped until a current-main affected-host repro identifies the exact blocker?
rationale: Current code intentionally caps channel restart attempts without process exit, while changing that boundary affects active sessions, operator expectations, and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Reproduce First, Then Choose Recovery
options.body: Keep this issue open, collect current-main affected-host proof, and choose process-level recovery only if channel/session fixes still leave Gateway probes timing out.

options.title: Add Supervised Recovery Policy
options.body: Define and implement a bounded Gateway watchdog or nonzero exit policy for unrecovered channel stalls with upgrade notes and Windows proof.

options.title: Stay Channel-Scoped
options.body: Continue closing narrower Telegram transport/session bugs and decline process-level recovery unless a fresh repro proves it is necessary.

recommendation.title: Reproduce First, Then Choose Recovery
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, collect current-main affected-host proof, and choose process-level recovery only if channel/session fixes still leave Gateway probes timing out.

likelyOwner.reason: They already performed the targeted live repro attempt and are the clearest routing owner for the remaining proof and recovery-policy decision.
